set.summary: About 49,000 Jews (JDC Archives: 48,000), nearly all from Yemen, were flown to Israel from a JDC transit camp in Aden in some 430-450 flights. The Jewish Virtual Library dates the launch of the operation to May 1949, after the Imam of Yemen agreed to let the Jews leave; the JDC Archives count the airlift from December 1948 (an early, small phase), and it ended on 19 September 1950. Many arrivals were placed in immigrant camps.

add_cite.claim: date: the operation was launched in May 1949, after the Imam of Yemen agreed to let the Jews leave
add_cite.quote: In May 1949, after the Imam of Yemen agreed to allow most of the Jews in his country to leave, Israel and Jewish relief organizations launched Operation Magic Carpet, also known as Operation On Wings of Eagles.

add_cite.claim: date_end: airlift ended 19 September 1950 (JDC also counts it from December 1948)
add_cite.quote: JDC planned, organized, and financed the mass exodus, which began in December 1948 and ended on September 19, 1950
